headline: DEFENDER's patrol mortality, measured: 74% of deaths are the planet
lede: Stage one of #3456 lands a dual-seed measurement rig (`npm run watchmeasure`) with a per-death taxonomy, and the first honest verdicts on six interception-brake designs against the now-mortal pilot. The arc continues; no sim laws moved.

notes.text: Taxonomy: 48+49 of 131 mortal patrol deaths are terrain grazes — the pre-fix designs all optimized score against a pilot that couldn't die twice; the planet, not the landers, is the killer.

Six look-ahead brake designs (V1-V6) drive terrain deaths to ~0 and survival to 20/19 of 40 — but every one breaches a bank/wave/delivery floor: guns and death share the same 16 px band, so a brake that forbids low flight forbids killing.
Trap named for the next lane: die() rewinds the player to the respawn seat, so death attribution must mirror the sim's decrement-then-collide order pre-step, not sample post-step.
Watch-slot mortality #3445 merged (slot b, PR #3457) — respawn grace burns every tick, GAME OVER is real, and the immortal-pilot WITNESS copy is retired from the README.

look.text: DEFENDER with an honest pilot: Smart Bomb on B, real GAME OVER after grace
